# cannabin-oid

> Free AI tool for UK medical cannabis patients. Identify strains, find dispensaries, connect with the community. Prescribed patients only. Colly's legacy.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cannabin-oid.co.uk/): Home — AI cannabis identifier and community for UK prescribed patients
- [The story](https://cannabin-oid.co.uk/story): The story — why cannabin-oid exists
- [Colly](https://cannabin-oid.co.uk/hamlet/colly): Colly — Donald Denzler memorial. Inventor of the VapBong. Gone April 2026.
- [Doc Strange's hamlet](https://cannabin-oid.co.uk/hamlet/doc): Doc Strange's hamlet — medical cannabis patient and advocate
- [Hamlet directory](https://cannabin-oid.co.uk/hamlet): Hamlet directory — community pages
